nodes.label: Robot
nodes.summary: MOMA fitted with one end-of-arm tool: Sander or Sprayer.
nodes.description: The working robot: the MOMA mobile manipulator carrying one interchangeable end-of-arm tool.

nodes.label: MOMA (Mobile Manipulator)
nodes.summary: Mobile base (AMR) with a robot arm that carries and drives the active tool.

nodes.label: Tool (End-of-Arm)
nodes.summary: Interchangeable end-of-arm tool on the MOMA arm. One fitted at a time.
nodes.description: Each tool has its own Tool Controller (STM32G491) that talks to the Tool Manager over CAN FD, and drives the EOA camera trigger, light and laser.

sources.title: Tool Controller – Sprayer Usage Guide V2

nodes.label: Tool Sander – EOA Vision Sander
nodes.summary: Mirka LEROS orbital drywall sander, 7 speeds (4,000–8,000 RPM), with camera, LED ring light & laser.
nodes.description: Mirka LEROS orbital sander driven by the Tool Controller Sander (speed levels 1–7, 4,000–8,000 RPM, LDR speed feedback). End-of-arm vision: LUCID Triton camera with synchronised high-power LED ring light (EoA Light Trigger Board) and laser for visual servoing along seams. Dust collection with vacuum bag and HEPA filter.

sources.title: Visual Servoing with EOA Sander – Architecture

nodes.label: Tool Sprayer – EOA Vision Sprayer
nodes.summary: Pneumatic autogun spray head with 0°/90° rotary actuator, ORBBEC camera, LED lights & laser.
nodes.description: Camera-enabled spray end-effector: autogun with nozzle and solenoid-valve (pneumatic) actuation, 0°/90° rotary actuator, ORBBEC Gemini 335Le camera for in-process inspection, LED lighting and a laser for alignment/servoing. Driven by the Tool Controller Sprayer over CAN FD.

sources.title: EOA Vision Sprayer – Design Document V2 to V3
Tool Controller – Sprayer Usage Guide V2

nodes.label: Accessories
nodes.summary: Separate units used on site alongside the robot.

nodes.label: Operation Station (OST)
nodes.summary: On-site power & charging hub: plugs into wall power, charges robot batteries, storage, E-stop.
nodes.description: Plugged into site wall power at setup. Charges robot batteries (for battery swaps) and other devices such as the tablet and power tools. Includes a charger, storage compartment, calibration-board mount and an operator E-stop (V2.2).

sources.title: OST V2.1 and V2.2 hardware differences

nodes.label: Hand Held Mapper (HHM)
nodes.summary: Handheld LiDAR + camera scanner used to map the room before the robot starts work.
nodes.description: Sensor stack of a LiDAR and a camera on a Jetson Orin compute module, with a tablet for the operator, its own battery/power bank and a PD power board. Used in the site-setup "Mapping" step before tasks are created.
